method: all m74 PNGs viewed on six labelled contact sheets; other host frames viewed on labelled contact sheet; selected editor and final History images also inspected full size
limitations: Fully masked pre-cover/startup images do not prove desktop behavior.
Some performance errors lost the owned UI context during finally-close; cover-only failure frames and the latest pre-failure context are retained.
Manual QA does not rewrite raw receipt review flags or establish blocked browser proof.
